### Stable Ammerow quest artefacts ###

name:'Last Measure'
base-object:hafted:Sounding Weight
level:100
weight:600
cost:420000
alloc:0:100 to 100
attack:8d12:20:40
armor:0:0
flags:IMPACT | SEE_INVIS | PROT_STUN
values:TUNNEL[6] | RES_SOUND[1]
act:EARTHQUAKES
time:35+d15
desc:An immense handled sounding weight assembled around a black Meridian core.
desc: Its sliding core returns a delayed impact through the handle.  Bracing the
desc: weight against the ground releases a deep survey shock; otherwise the core
desc: takes the jarring force from its bearer.  There are no names on its striking
desc: face.  Last Measure was built to test foundations, not to judge their makers.

armor:0:0
